name: Shared-context candidate ranking and inexpensive ML
mixture_assignment: Index modulo 4 selects group; floor(index/4) modulo 3 selects attack severity. Original hidden worlds and candidate sets retained; one observation realization per world.
early_stopping: Mean of four validation group means of each family total loss. Same rule, different candidate versus fact prediction targets.
primary: SCR minus ID macro regret across benign0 and targeted/random/coherent0.2, facts64/budget2048/missing0.2
bootstrap: 2000 paired crossed seed/topology draws; same clusters across seeds and paired conditions
old_test_role: 32027/42027/52027 development only. New pilot72027. Frozen fresh confirmation pool62027.
novelty_scope: Task-specific composition of canonical prerequisite set aggregation and a shared latent expert gate; Deep Sets, mixtures, denoising autoencoders and decision-focused learning are established.
budget_scope: SCR/CTX/LOCAL predict candidate feasibility directly; fact-level repair metrics do not exist. ID/JH/DAE/LOGIT reconstruct all fact beliefs.
wire_scope: All methods retain the same sparse report codec; no HDC wire-compression claim.
consistency_regularizer: LOGIT/DAE only: mean squared ReLU(child marginal minus parent marginal). Direct models have no fact marginals and no fact consistency term.
pretraining: Only DAE receives 5 observed-feature denoising epochs (mask .25, Gaussian noise std .05). Other new models start supervised training directly. Prior checkpoints unchanged.
inputs: Observed x_f, parent x, observed global moments. No candidate-specific values/costs tensors in feasibility heads; inherited x channel12 contains catalogue value-weighted criticality. No group/corruption/truth/oracle labels at inference.
canonicalization: Pool required nonroot children, unique touched roots and two log1p cardinalities; adding a redundant root is invariant.
shadow_union: Core conditions only: fraction q(Rj union Rj+1)>min(qj,qj+1)+1e-4. Up to10 required facts versus training2..5; diagnostic only, no test tuning.
gate_diagnostics: Entropy in nats and mean four latent weights; expert identities are not identified attack classes.
